meta.name: The Cavern Club The Beat Goes On
meta.description: Presented by Paul McGann, The Cavern Club and LA Factual have come together to produce "The Cavern Club: The Beat Goes On" - a unique documentary feature, telling the untold, complete and colourful story of the 'greatest club in the world'.
meta.slogan: A club that remains the beating heart of Liverpool’s iconic music scene and quite rightly takes its position on the world’s stage.
